name: week-plays-{DAY}
title: Week plays {DAY}
subtitle: Short-term trades for the rest of the earnings week: every name printing this week with its buy-in-red band and kill, the alpha model's deciles and 7d / 28d bands, the signal-lab print cell it sits in now (with that cell's measured mean, t and n), its balance sheet and volatility; then the Book with the same columns. Each table is one order; nothing is a sum. Then yesterday's calls against today's tape and the alpha model's month-ahead read per industry.
sources_extra: play_review {PACK}/play_review (tv_scan_cli.py play-review --pack {PACK} --quiet: the prior judgment against this pack)

blocks.title: Week plays in reading order (judgment; size is advice: $5,000 starter, about $1,000 add)
Prior week-plays list in its reading order: return to this scan, against the tape, and where the price sat against the published band

source.sql: SELECT symbol, course, play_rank, prior_close, close, ret_pct, ret_fx, bounce_low, bounce_high, bounce_kill, path, open_state, min_state, close_state, close_vs_bhigh_pct, now_phase, now_react_fx, now_surprise_mix, now_mix_mean, prior_dec_28d, now_dec_28d FROM calls WHERE play_rank IS NOT NULL ORDER BY play_rank

blocks.title: Return against the tape per prior course (every name the prior judgment ruled on)

source.sql: SELECT course, n, ret_fx_mean, ret_fx_median, up_share FROM by_course ORDER BY n DESC

blocks.title: Prior action courses (NEW / ADD / BUY_PRE / BUY_DIP_AFTER / TRIM / EXIT / DERISK / SHORT), ret_fx ascending

source.sql: SELECT symbol, course, grade, prior_close, close, ret_pct, ret_fx, entry_low, entry_high, kill_px, entry_state, close_state, now_phase, now_react_fx FROM calls WHERE course IN ('NEW','ADD','BUY_PRE','BUY_DIP_AFTER','TRIM','TRIM_FIRST','EXIT','DERISK','DERISK_INTO_PRINT','SHORT','SHORT_PRE','SELL_THE_NEWS') ORDER BY ret_fx NULLS LAST

blocks.title: Per play: thesis, what breaks it, the trigger, read-throughs (judgment)

blocks.text: The judgment's shortlist in reading order. bounce_low..bounce_high is the buy-in-red band under the close and bounce_kill ends that entry (safety band). The alpha band b7d_q20..b7d_q80 is the model's 20th to 80th percentile 7-day price on a flat market. Distances are percent of the bounce band middle (bmid).

blocks.title: Levels and upside from the band

source.sql: SELECT symbol, phase, earn_dow, slot, close, bounce_low, bounce_high, bounce_kill, bkill_vs_bmid_pct, bmid_vs_close_pct, b7d_q20, b7d_q80, q80_7d_vs_bmid_pct, b28d_q80, q80_28d_vs_bmid_pct, pt, street_vs_bmid_pct, react_abs_mean, trim_zone FROM plays

blocks.title: Model and evidence per play

source.sql: SELECT symbol, dec_7d, pred_7d, dec_28d, pred_28d, setup_cell, setup_mean, setup_t, setup_n, rev_q_cell, rev_q_mean, rev_q_t, runup_q_cell, runup_q_mean, runup_q_t, mix_cell, mix_mean, mix_t, big_cell, big_mean, big_t, why_28d FROM plays

blocks.title: Financial risk per play

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ROUND(mcap / 1e9, 1) AS mcap_b, nd_ebitda, fcf_margin, opm, vol_d, atrp, eps_rev_3m, eps_q_step, rev_yoy, pe_nfy, pe_nfy_vs_ind, pe_nfy_vs_own, mos_own_med_pct, mos_peer_pct, lenses, weak_lens, react_hist FROM plays

blocks.title: This week, not printed, sold into the print and previous print down (the best measured pre-print cell), $2B+, alpha 28d decile descending

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ind, earn_dow, slot, ROUND(mcap / 1e9, 1) AS mcap_b, close, runup, react_last, eps_rev_3m, rev_q_cell, rev_q_mean, setup_rx_q10, rx_tail_usd, dec_7d, dec_28d, bounce_low, bounce_high, bounce_kill, q80_7d_vs_bmid_pct, nd_ebitda, fcf_margin, vol_d FROM plays WHERE week = 'W0' AND phase = 'pre' AND setup_cell = 'sold into & previous print down' AND mcap >= 2e9 ORDER BY dec_28d DESC NULLS LAST, mcap DESC LIMIT 60

blocks.title: This week, not printed, ran into the print after a previous print up (the weakest measured cell): sell-the-news exposure, $2B+, runup descending

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ind, earn_dow, slot, ROUND(mcap / 1e9, 1) AS mcap_b, runup, react_last, eps_rev_3m, rev_q_cell, setup_mean, dec_28d, pt_up, book_usd FROM plays WHERE week = 'W0' AND phase = 'pre' AND setup_cell = 'ran into & previous print up' AND mcap >= 2e9 ORDER BY runup DESC LIMIT 30

blocks.title: Printed this week, $2B+, reaction vs the tape ascending (sold-off prints first)

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ind, earn_dow, slot, ROUND(mcap / 1e9, 1) AS mcap_b, day, react_fx, last_surprise, rev_surprise, surprise_mix, rev_posted, mix_mean, mix_t, big_cell, big_mean, big_t, rx_q_mean, setrx_cell, setrx_mean, setrx_t, ah_q_cell, ah_q_mean, ah_q_q10, dec_28d, bounce_low, bounce_high, bounce_kill, pt_up, nd_ebitda, fcf_margin FROM plays WHERE phase = 'post' AND mcap >= 2e9 ORDER BY react_fx NULLS LAST LIMIT 40

blocks.title: Holding verdicts (judgment)
Book lines: weight, print, model, levels

source.sql: SELECT symbol, wt_nav, vs_cost, phase, earn_date, slot, close, dec_7d, dec_28d, pred_28d, q20_28d_pct, q80_28d_pct, bounce_low, bounce_high, bounce_kill, trim_zone, sma50_px, trim33_cash FROM book ORDER BY wt_nav DESC NULLS LAST

blocks.title: Book lines: balance sheet, estimates, print cell

source.sql: SELECT symbol, nd_ebitda, fcf_margin, opm, vol_d, eps_rev_3m, eps_q_step, last_surprise, surprise_mix, pe_nfy_vs_ind, lenses, weak_lens, setup_cell, setup_mean, setup_rx_q10, rx_tail_usd, mix_cell, mix_mean, setrx_cell, setrx_mean, why_28d FROM book ORDER BY wt_nav DESC NULLS LAST

blocks.title: W1, sold into the print and previous print down, $5B+, in time order

source.sql: SELECT symbol, ind, earn_date, earn_dow, slot, ROUND(mcap / 1e9, 1) AS mcap_b, runup, react_last, eps_rev_3m, rev_q_cell, dec_7d, dec_28d, pt_up, nd_ebitda, fcf_margin, vol_d, book_usd FROM plays WHERE week = 'W1' AND setup_cell = 'sold into & previous print down' AND mcap >= 5e9 ORDER BY earn_utc, mcap DESC LIMIT 60

blocks.title: Industries on the alpha model's 28-day forecast (median pred_28d descending; a regime read, not a buy list)

source.sql: SELECT ind, n, pred_28d_med, dec_28d_mean, dec10_share, dec1_share, r_1m_med, p_def_med, leaders, book FROM month_ind WHERE n >= 5 ORDER BY pred_28d_med DESC NULLS LAST

blocks.title: Strong players for the month: 28-day decile 10, $5B+, pred_28d descending

source.sql: SELECT symbol, company, ind, mcap_b, close, pred_28d, b28d_q20, b28d_q50, b28d_q80, pred_56d, dec_56d, p_def, p_dvc, r_1m, eps_rev_3m, fwd_eps_g, pe_nfy_vs_ind, lenses, weak_lens, tape_state, earn_date, why_28d, book_usd FROM month WHERE dec_28d >= 10 AND mcap_b >= 5 ORDER BY pred_28d DESC LIMIT 50

blocks.title: Weakest for the month: 28-day decile 1, $5B+, pred_28d ascending (what the regime is selling)

source.sql: SELECT symbol, company, ind, mcap_b, close, pred_28d, b28d_q20, b28d_q80, p_def, r_1m, eps_rev_3m, lenses, weak_lens, tape_state, why_28d, book_usd FROM month WHERE dec_28d <= 1 AND mcap_b >= 5 ORDER BY pred_28d LIMIT 30

blocks.text: The signal-lab cells the week-plays columns point at (all prints since March, US $1B+). hold is from the close before the print, drift from the reaction close, both over the US $1B+ median. Print t-stats treat prints as independent, and prints cluster in earnings season: read them as optimistic.

blocks.title: Pre-print cells (hold-through)

source.sql: SELECT study, cell, n, react_fx_mean, react_fx_hit, react_fx_q10, react_fx_q90, hold_fx_7d_mean, hold_fx_28d_mean, hold_fx_28d_hit, hold_fx_28d_q10, hold_fx_28d_t FROM cells WHERE hold_fx_28d_n IS NOT NULL AND study <> 'set-up x reaction' ORDER BY study, cell

blocks.title: Post-print cells (drift after the reaction)

source.sql: SELECT study, cell, n, react_fx_mean, ah_to_close_mean, ah_to_close_t, drift_fx_7d_mean, drift_fx_28d_mean, drift_fx_28d_hit, drift_fx_28d_t, hold_fx_28d_mean FROM cells WHERE drift_fx_28d_n IS NOT NULL ORDER BY study, cell
